kpis.description_fr: ~7 BCFe/j = #1 producteur gaz naturel USA post-fusion Chesapeake + Southwestern. Concentration Marcellus + Haynesville.
kpis.description_en: ~7 BCFe/d = #1 US natural gas producer post Chesapeake + Southwestern merger. Marcellus + Haynesville concentration.

kpis.description_fr: Marcellus (NE PA) = ~52 % production EXE. Low-cost bassin, accès demande NE + LNG export. Coeur d'inventaire.
kpis.description_en: Marcellus (NE PA) = ~52% of EXE production. Low-cost basin, access to NE demand + LNG export. Inventory core.

kpis.description_fr: Haynesville (TX/LA) = ~37 % production. Accès Gulf Coast LNG export terminals. Driver futur tailwind LNG.
kpis.description_en: Haynesville (TX/LA) = ~37% of production. Gulf Coast LNG export terminal access. Future LNG export tailwind driver.

kpis.description_fr: Inventaire premium ~15 ans à rythme actuel. Plus longue runway USA gas. Visibilité décennale.
kpis.description_en: Premium inventory ~15 years at current pace. Longest US gas runway. Multi-decade visibility.

kpis.name_en: FCF Yield Sensitivity to Gas Price
kpis.description_fr: Très haute sensibilité au prix Henry Hub. À ~3 $/mcf : FCF yield ~5-8 %. À ~4 $/mcf : FCF yield ~12-15 %. Option pure-play gas.
kpis.description_en: Very high sensitivity to Henry Hub gas price. At ~$3/mcf: FCF yield ~5-8%. At ~$4/mcf: FCF yield ~12-15%. Pure-play gas option.

notes: Expand Energy (EXE) issu fusion Chesapeake + Southwestern Energy oct 2024 — données 2024 reflètent post-merger.
